app.title: Show HN: WhatsApp MCP running free on Cloudflare
app.author: zoozla
app.description: A lightweight wrapper to run WhatsApp Multi-Client Protocol (MCP) on Cloudflare workers, enabling free access to WhatsApp messaging.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `npm install`.
Execute `node index.js --help` to verify CLI availability.
Start the worker with `npm run dev` and send a test message via the API.
Measure latency of message delivery and compare against a standard WhatsApp client.
Check for graceful shutdown and error handling.
